description: This PHP class defines the 'EmpDirectDebit' entity for a Human Resource Management System, representing direct debit information associated with an employee's salary. It includes properties such as routing number, account details, amount, account type, and transaction type, along with getter and setter methods. The class is mapped with Doctrine ORM annotations, indicating its use with a database via ORM.

classes.name: EmpDirectDebit
classes.description: Entity class representing direct debit details for employee salary payments, including routing number, account info, amount, and transaction details.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the direct debit record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the direct debit record.

methods.name: getSalary
methods.description: Returns the employee's salary entity associated with this direct debit.

methods.name: setSalary
methods.description: Associates an EmployeeSalary entity with this direct debit.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount for the direct debit.

methods.name: setAmount
methods.description: Sets the amount for the direct debit.

methods.name: getAccountType
methods.description: Returns the account type, e.g., savings or checking.
